speech_act.description: Deterministic form of the stored utterance at ingress; independent of memory topic/lobe routing.

temporal_epoch_us.description: Ingest timestamp represented as Unix epoch microseconds for deterministic temporal fallback ranking.

temporal_hash.description: Lexically sortable ingest-time key: epoch microseconds plus a stable memory-id digest.

trait.description: Structured identity preference promoted only after repeated independent evidence.

trait_observation.description: Unpromoted, retry-safe identity-pattern evidence. Never treated as a system preference.

workspace_source.description: Strict Workspace observation lineage. Facts derived from Workspace keep this source object through projection and recall.

enrichment.description: Decomposer-produced 5W1H entities and metadata for this memory.

domain.description: Knowledge domain (e.g. neuroscience, topology). Used for three-tier routing.

subtopic.description: Specific subtopic within the domain (e.g. Neuron, Homology).

write_strength.description: FU-1 encoding strength = base(cycle_kind) × plasticity.strength (PlasticitySignal.strength is bounded [0,1]; base max 0.85). Distinct top-level field the deep-sleep readers (mastery_tracker / consolidation / pruning) key on, separate from provenance.confidence to avoid double-counting in the mastery formula. Absent on pre-FU-1 records; readers default to 0.5.

supersedes.description: Revision chain (memory.supersedes): id of the prior memory this one supersedes. null/absent = not a revision. Schema made honest 2026-05-18 — the chain writer (supersedes.py) legitimately stamps this; with additionalProperties:false its absence here silently erased every revised memory from coord_index on reindex and rolled back re-encodes (audit F2/F3).

superseded_by.description: Revision chain back-edge: id of the memory that supersedes this one. null = current head of the chain.

version.description: Revision chain version (1-based, monotonic). Absent on un-chained records.
